text: やっぱり　やるの　やめた！

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like 'giving'. The を after it is dropped. やるの = 'the giving'.

patterns.name: 〜のをやめる
patterns.explanation: A verb with の and then やめる means deciding not to do it after all. やるの　やめた = 'I've decided not to give you any'.
